HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

2. Which response best shows understanding of Indian Traditional Calendar? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Indian Traditional Calendar with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Indian Traditional Calendar has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Indian Traditional Calendar to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Indian Traditional Calendar.

3. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Cheating in exams

4. Which response best shows understanding of Pranayam? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pranayam.
   B. Say Pranayam has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Pranayam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Pranayam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Dainik Prarthana? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Dainik Prarthana.
   B. Use Dainik Prarthana to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Dainik Prarthana has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Dainik Prarthana with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Social and National Festivals? (1 mark)
   A. Say Social and National Festivals has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Social and National Festivals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Social and National Festivals to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Social and National Festivals.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Social and National festivals 10 8.2. Indian Traditional Calender 10 NOTE: The s? (1 mark)
   A. Use Social and National festivals 10 8.2. Indian Traditional Calender 10 NOTE: The s to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Social and National festivals 10 8.2. Indian Traditional Calender 10 NOTE: The s.
   C. Say Social and National festivals 10 8.2. Indian Traditional Calender 10 NOTE: The s has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Social and National festivals 10 8.2. Indian Traditional Calender 10 NOTE: The s with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Indian Traditional Calender 10 NOTE: The suggested number of lessons per sub str? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Indian Traditional Calender 10 NOTE: The suggested number of lessons per sub str with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Indian Traditional Calender 10 NOTE: The suggested number of lessons per sub str.
   C. Say Indian Traditional Calender 10 NOTE: The suggested number of lessons per sub str has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Indian Traditional Calender 10 NOTE: The suggested number of lessons per sub str to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Aspects of Integrity. 10 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles o? (1 mark)

   B. Say Aspects of Integrity. 10 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles o has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Aspects of Integrity. 10 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles o to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Aspects of Integrity. 10 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles o with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Destroy trees without planting

11. Which response best shows understanding of Panch- mahabhoot? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Panch- mahabhoot.
   B. Use Panch- mahabhoot to insult classmates of other faiths.

13. Which response best shows understanding of Aspects of integrity? (1 mark)
